notes.title: Sequel!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Finally: You can wishlist the second entry of the Markus Ritter series. Ghosts Of The Past will be released august 2023.

[previewyoutube=a_aIJyspzA0;full][/previewyoutube]
If you don't follow us on Kickstarter or other Social Media, we have been working over a year now on the sequel and already posted a few behind the scenes sneak peeks on Instagram and Twitter.
It would help us a lot if you could already add the Game to your wishlist, and you also won't miss the release that way!
[previewyoutube=Iz5B-vu90yc;full][/previewyoutube]

Your Markus Ritter Team
